query: For a 69‑year‑old man with TIA, among male TIA patients aged 64–74 (LOS 1–7 days), what's the mean ultrasounds/echocardiograms per admission: 1–3 vs 4–7 days, stratified by ICU use?
final_sql:
SELECT p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, i.intime, i.outtime, i.los, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 64 AND 74 AND p.anchor_year_group = 'LOS 1–7 days' THEN d.itemid END)::FLOAT / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 64 AND 74 AND p.anchor_year_group = 'LOS 4–7 days' THEN d.itemid END), 0) AS ratio FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN icustays i ON a.stay_id = i.stay_id JOIN chartevents c ON a.hadm_id = c.hadm_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON c.itemid = d.icd_code WHERE d.icd_code = '412' -- TIA
GROUP BY p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, i.intime, i.outtime, i.los ORDER BY p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, i.intime, i.outtime, i.los NULLS LAST;
